# Abstract Enterprises Security Systems

> Licensed New York low-voltage contractor (NYS Low-Voltage License #12000287431) installing and servicing security cameras, video intercoms, access control, alarm systems, structured cabling/networks and TV mounting. Serves all five NYC boroughs, Long Island (Nassau, Suffolk) and the Hudson Valley (Westchester, Rockland, Orange, Putnam, Dutchess, Ulster). Offices in Brooklyn and the Bronx. Open 8 AM-8 PM, 7 days. Phone (800) 486-0943. No monthly fees on camera systems; customers own their equipment.

## Services
- [Security camera installation (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/security-camera-installation-nyc): 4K IP and HD analog camera systems with local NVR/DVR recording, phone viewing, no monthly fees
- [Security camera repair (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/security-camera-repair-nyc): service calls for existing camera systems
- [Video intercom installation (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/intercom-installation-nyc): apartment buildings, brownstones and businesses
- [Intercom repair (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/intercom-repair-nyc)
- [Access control installation (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/access-control-installation-nyc): key fob, card reader, maglock and electric strike entry
- [Alarm system installation (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/alarm-installation-nyc)
- [Fire alarm installation (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/fire-alarm-installation-nyc)
- [Structured cabling (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/structured-cabling-installation-nyc): Cat6/Cat6a drops, network closets
- [Network installation (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/network-installation-nyc)
- [TV mounting and installation (NYC)](https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/tv-installation-nyc): book and pay online; policies at https://www.abstractenterprisessecuritysystems.com/tv-installation-policies
